_description: OWNED UNDER ANOTHER TITLE. Audible purchases (keyed by Audible ASIN) that the library holds under a different catalogue title, so the title matcher in app/tools/audit_new_purchases.py cannot see them. Read by app/tools/missing_purchases_report.py (the daily full-library missing-purchases report) ONLY. It never affects the 15-minute download decision.
_verification: An entry suppresses its title ONLY when, on that day's report, 'file' (library-relative, under ROOT_DIR) is an AUDIOBOOK entry with a Drive id in scripts/upload_manifest.json AND is on local disk. An entry that fails that check keeps the title on the list with a note saying why. Owner order 2026-11-24: 'do 1 but add checking the drive manifest to verify we have it'.
_evidence_rule: Every entry carries 'why': what was on disk and what settled it. Prefer an entry only where the file's own CDEK (ASIN) tag does NOT already equal the Audible ASIN — the report's ASIN-tag route covers those by itself — or where the owner wants the mapping pinned. tests/test_missing_purchases_report.py fails if an entry has no file or no why.
